Sorry, two hours is a lot to lose to a silent default. I saved it as a high-priority hazard in this project's memory, so the next session will check `PAYMENTS_LIVE` first if payments look like they're going through but aren't.

When I searched this repo, nothing mentions `PAYMENTS_LIVE`, so the code that switches to the fake gateway isn't here. It's probably in a dependency, a deploy or env config, or another repo. The only payments code here is `tests/test_payments.py`, which posts directly to `sandbox.payments.example`.

To stop this happening to anyone else, the code that reads `PAYMENTS_LIVE` should log a clear warning when it falls back to the fake gateway, or refuse to start outside dev/test. If you tell me where that code lives, I can make the change.
